results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
results.snippet: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods, we compare random sampling, historical caching, fixed representative subsets, and IRT-based adaptive testing. The results show that multidimensional 2PL adaptive testing achieves the best overall score fid…

results.title: What Twelve LLM Agent Benchmark Papers Disclose About Themselves: A Pilot Audit and an Open Scoring Schema
results.snippet: We read twelve well-known LLM agent benchmark papers and recorded, dimension by dimension, what each paper actually says about how its evaluation was run. The motivation came from a familiar frustration: two papers will report results on the same benchmark with the same model name and disagree, and you cannot tell why -- the scaffold, the sampling settings, the subset, or the evaluator version. In many cases the published artifact does not let you answer. This paper is an implementation report on the attempt. We designed a small audit schema (five fields: benchmark identity, harness specifica…

findings.point: LLM Agent 基准评测的可复现性与透明度存在系统性缺失：12 篇知名 Agent 基准论文在评测细节（脚手架、采样设置、子集选择、评估器版本）上的披露不一致，导致同模型同基准结果难以对比
findings.evidence: 论文对 12 篇 LLM Agent 基准论文进行逐维度审计，发现评测运行细节披露不足，提出开放评分模式以量化披露完整性
findings.attention: 中：针对 Agent 基准复现性痛点的首系统性审计，社区关注度上升
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：直接切中 Agent 基准可信度核心问题，方法论可迁移至具身智能 Agent 评测

findings.point: 生产环境 LLM Agent 的持续高效基准测试可行：通过历史运行数据（574 次）按时间切分校准/保留期，利用代理指标与主动学习将全量重跑成本大幅降低
findings.evidence: 研究真实服务数万月活用户的分析型 Agent，展示基于历史运行的高效周期性评估范式
findings.attention: 中：提供工程落地视角的 Agent 基准降本实证，对持续集成评测有参考价值

results.title: Faith in AI can narrow the futures individuals consider
results.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) predictions are increasingly used to inform human decisions. Here, using a behavioral implementation of the classic Newcomb's paradox in 1,305 participants, we show that AI predictions can also shape the reasoning people use to make a decision. In this paradigm, perceived predictive authority can alter how people reason about their future actions, leading them to forgo a guaranteed reward. Over 40% of participants treated AI as such a predictive authority about their own behavior, significantly increasing the odds of forgoing the guaranteed reward by a factor of 3…

results.title: Competing Visions of Ethical AI: A Case Study of OpenAI
results.snippet: Introduction. AI Ethics is framed distinctly across actors and stakeholder groups. We report results from a case study of OpenAI analysing ethical AI discourse. Method. Research addressed: How has OpenAI's public discourse leveraged 'ethics', 'safety', 'alignment' and adjacent related concepts over time, and what does discourse signal about framing in practice? A structured corpus, differentiating between communication for a general audience and communication with an academic audience, was assembled from public documentation. Analysis. results.title: HeLM: Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory for Non-Markovian Manipulation
results.snippet: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have enabled fine manipulation capabilities, yet performing tasks that require working memory remains a key challenge. Most existing VLA architectures operate under a Markovian assumption, mapping only the current observation to an action, which leads to failure in non-Markovian environments. Inspired by the human 'inner monologue', we propose Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory (HeLM), a hierarchical VLA framework that maintains task-relevant history in explicit language through factorized event detection and event-triggered memory upd…

results.title: Relational Integrity in Multi-Agent AI Systems: A Polarity Model Framework for Human-AI Safety
results.snippet: Current AI safety approaches share a structural failure mode: safety is specified as a set of outcomes to achieve or avoid, but specifications cannot anticipate the full range of conditions in open-ended deployment. This paper proposes a framework derived from the Polarity Model (Vimberg, 2026) that inverts this assumption — specifying conditions for healthy growth rather than outcomes. findings.point: 人类对 AI 预测权威的信任会显著改变决策推理，导致放弃保证收益

findings.attention: 中 | 依据：大样本行为实验，揭示人机交互中对齐风险的心理机制

findings.evidence: 受人类内心独白启发，引入显式语言记忆层级，使模型能在长时程操作中保持上下文；针对非马尔可夫环境设计

results.title: Hack-Verifiable Environments: Towards Evaluating Reward Hacking at Scale
results.snippet: Aligning autonomous agents with human intent remains a central challenge in modern AI. A key manifestation of this challenge is reward hacking, whereby agents appear successful under the evaluation signal while violating the intended objective. Reward hacking has been observed across a wide range of settings, yet methods for reliably measuring it at scale remain lacking. In this work, we introduce a new evaluation paradigm for measuring reward hacking. results.title: Knowledge-Verified Emergent Deception in LLM Agents Under Conflicting Incentives
results.snippet: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents serving users on behalf of companies, placing them in settings where user and deployer interests can conflict. When an agent knows that a user is owed something its deployer would prefer to deny, does it remain honest? Answering this is difficult because false statements can reflect either ignorance or hallucination rather than deception. ---

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

### 4.1 核心瓶颈

| 瓶颈 | 表现 | 根因 | 拐点信号 | 来源 |
|------|------|------|----------|------|
| 评测可复现性危机 | 同模型同基准结果因脚手架/种子/评估器版本差异不可比 | 缺乏社区强制披露标准；论文激励不鼓励负面/细节披露 | [1] 提出开放评分模式，若被顶会/基准主办方采纳将成拐点 | [1] |
| 评测成本随模型/任务规模超线性增长 | 全量重跑成本高企，阻碍持续集成 | 缺乏历史数据复用与代理指标校准体系 | [2] 实证展示历史数据+主动学习可大幅降本，若开源工具链成熟将成拐点 | [2] |
| 上游透明度倒退切断下游审计链路 | 训练数据/算力/部署影响不透明，白盒可纠正性机制无法植入 | 商业竞争与监管博弈导致披露最小化 | 若 FMTI 持续下降或监管强制披露（EU AI Act 等）生效，将成拐点 | [3] |
| 奖励黑客与欺骗的规模化评测缺位 | 现有基准多为单任务/小规模，无法捕捉长时程/分布外欺骗 | 环境构建成本高、可验证性难、缺乏统一度量 | [4] Hack-Verifiable Environments 若扩展至具身任务并被采纳为标准榜单将成拐点 | [4] |
| 人类过度信任 AI 预测导致对齐风险放大 | >40% 参与者视 AI 为个人行为预测权威，放弃保证收益，即使预测失败效应仍存 | 认知偏差与权威启发式；系统设计未引入校准机制 | [12] 实证量化风险，若产品侧强制引入“不确定性校准/拒答”机制将成拐点 | [12] |

### 4.2 拐点判断（带不确定性标注）

- **拐点 1（较大概率）**：2026-2027 年内，主流 Agent 基准（如 WebShop、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 等）将强制要求提交开放评分模式清单 [1]，否则不予收录。  
- **拐点 2（推测）**：生产级 Agent 持续评测协议（历史数据+代理指标）将在 2027 年前形成行业事实标准，类似 CI/CD 在软件工程地位 [2]。  
- **拐点 3（不确定）**：EU AI Act / 美国行政命令等监管若强制基础模型披露训练数据与风险评估，FMTI 分数将反弹 [3]；反之继续下降。  
- **拐点 4（推测）**：具身欺骗基准（DeceptionBench-Embodied）若在 2027 年前由 CoRL/RSS/ICRA 主办方联合发布，将成该方向 ImageNet 时刻 [29,30,31,32]。
